_about: Batch B5 (Feature registries): concepts/attention-backend-selection, concepts/quantization-plugins, concepts/kv-connectors, concepts/frontend-plugins, concepts/engine-hooks, code/distributed-kv-transfer-kv-connector-factory. Owner: the B5 writer.

attention-backend-enum.short: The enum that names every attention backend. Each value is the default dotted class path; register_backend can override it or add a member.
attention-backend-enum.long: Defined at {{cite vllm/v1/attention/backends/registry.py:34-166}} (49 members). Overrides live in _ATTN_OVERRIDES ({{cite vllm/v1/attention/backends/registry.py:344}}).

backend-priority.short: The ordered list of attention backends that a platform tries for one kind of layer. The first backend that passes validate_configuration wins.
backend-priority.long: CUDA builds the list in _get_backend_priorities ({{cite vllm/platforms/cuda.py:84-181}}), keyed by MLA or not and the compute capability.

quantization-config.short: The base class of a quantization method. One object holds the checkpoint settings and returns a quantize method for each layer through get_quant_method.

quantize-method.short: The per-layer object that makes a layer's quantized weights (create_weights), runs its forward (apply) and post-processes the loaded weights.
quantize-method.long: Base class QuantizeMethodBase ({{cite vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/base_config.py:23-95}}). A linear layer stores it as self.quant_method ({{cite vllm/model_executor/layers/linear.py:290-296}}).

kv-connector.short: A plugin class that moves KV cache blocks between a vLLM instance and something outside it: another instance, CPU memory or a storage system.

connector-role.short: The half of a KV connector that an object plays: SCHEDULER (in the engine core, plans loads and saves) or WORKER (in each worker, moves the data).
connector-role.long: KVConnectorRole ({{cite vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/base.py:139-144}}). Not the same as kv_role (producer or consumer).

kv-transfer-config.short: The config that turns on a KV connector: kv_connector (the name), kv_role (kv_producer, kv_consumer or kv_both) and kv_connector_extra_config. Set with --kv-transfer-config.
kv-transfer-config.long: Defined at {{cite vllm/config/kv_transfer.py:56-91}}; a connector name without a role raises ({{cite vllm/config/kv_transfer.py:120-124}}).

ec-connector.short: An encoder-cache connector. It moves the outputs of a multimodal encoder between vLLM instances, with the same scheduler and worker roles as a KV connector.

kv-offloading.short: Copying KV cache blocks to CPU memory or storage, so that a later request can load them again instead of computing the prefill again.
kv-offloading.long: --kv-offloading-size turns it on through a KV connector ({{cite vllm/config/vllm.py:1133-1167}}); the native code is in vllm/v1/kv_offload/.

tool-parser.short: A class in the API server that turns the model's text into OpenAI tool calls. --tool-call-parser selects it by name.

reasoning-parser.short: A class that splits the model's reasoning text from its answer. --reasoning-parser selects it; the API server and the engine core both use it.

stat-logger.short: An object in the API server that receives the scheduler and iteration statistics of each step, for example the Prometheus logger. Plugins add more.
stat-logger.long: Base class StatLoggerBase ({{cite vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py:54-81}}); plugin group vllm.stat_logger_plugins ({{cite vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py:84-98}}).

scheduler-cls.short: A config field (--scheduler-cls) that names the scheduler class of the engine core. Not set: AsyncScheduler with async scheduling, else Scheduler.
scheduler-cls.long: Field at {{cite vllm/config/scheduler.py:177}}; resolved by get_scheduler_cls ({{cite vllm/config/scheduler.py:231-256}}).

worker-extension.short: A class named by --worker-extension-cls. vLLM adds it as a base class of the worker class, so its methods become callable with collective_rpc.

model-loader.short: A class that builds the model and loads its weights for one --load-format, for example safetensors, dummy or tensorizer.

sleep-mode.short: A feature that frees most GPU memory of an idle engine and restores it later. A sleep-mode backend does the work; the built-in one is cumem.
sleep-mode.long: Turned on with --enable-sleep-mode ({{cite vllm/config/model.py:370-372}}); backends in SleepModeBackendFactory ({{cite vllm/device_allocator/sleep_mode_backend.py:160-214}}).
